title: ‘Take temperature down’ over guidance on single-sex spaces, head of UK equalities body urges
summary_full: EHRC chair says ‘misinformation’ about guidance issued after supreme court ruling has created ‘more anxiety’The head of the UK’s equalities watchdog has urged people to “take the temperature down” on reaction to guidance issued on single-sex spaces.Mary-Ann Stephenson, the chair of the Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC), appearing before MSPs in Holyrood, said “misinformation” over the body’s guidance had created “more anxiety among people”.
